india.one_line: MeitY examines home services data practices while ReNew invests ₹80,000 crore in green AI infrastructure in Andhra Pradesh.

themes.title: MeitY questions home services video collection
themes.text: MeitY questioned home services platforms and robotics companies regarding worker consent, privacy protections, and data retention for in-home video footage used to train physical AI models.

stories.headline: MeitY questions home services platforms over in-home video data collection for AI

themes.title: ReNew pledges ₹80,000 crore for data centre
themes.text: ReNew Energy Global announced an investment of approximately ₹80,000 crore to build a 1 GW green hyperscale data centre and clean energy manufacturing facilities in Andhra Pradesh.

stories.headline: ReNew pledges ₹80,000 cr for green data centre and manufacturing in Andhra Pradesh

themes.title: NITI Aayog warns of AI concentration risks
themes.text: NITI Aayog's Debjani Ghosh warned that the concentration of capital, influence, and circular financing among a few companies poses systemic risks and weakens competition.

stories.headline: Niti Aayog's Debjani Ghosh warns AI risk lies in capital and power concentration
